svg.title: Bidirectional TriMul training: B7–B12 in one CUDA kernel
svg.desc: Fused-input-LN forward saves remain unchanged. One cooperative kernel assigns 104 CTAs to B7 and B8 weight gradients, and 160 CTAs to B7, B9, B10, input LN backward and residual. Large intermediates remain on chip; small parameter partials are reduced inside the same launch.
svg.text: TriMul · B7–B12 · ONE CUDA launch
H100 / BF16 / L384, L768 / C128 / left + right width 256 each / dropout 25%
Forward stays fused: input LN + projection/gate
Existing saves: x_n, mean, inverse std, interleaved gate/projection preactivations; original x retained
B1–B4: separate development · B5–B6: existing cuBLAS contractions → d_left, d_right
front_b7b12 · cooperative grid · 264 CTAs × 256 threads
Anthropic native v5 TMA/WGMMA primitives → MiniWorld training extension
104 CTAs · weight-gradient role
8 hidden groups × 13 splits × 2 accumulation segments
B7 · mask + sigmoid/GLU backward
TMA: d_left/right + preactivation + saved x_n
B8 · WGMMA weight gradients
dW = B7 gradient × x_n
Two WGs: gate/projection · N128 WGMMA · no d_concat
Write FP32 dW partials: 13 MiB total
Four input matrices; final BF16 conversion after sum
No concatenated weight buffer or transpose copies
160 CTAs · input-gradient role
One CTA owns all 128 input channels for a 64-row tile
B9 · WGMMA output-gate dgrad
d_glogit × W_gateᵀ → BF16 gate contribution in registers
B7 + B10 · GLU backward + front dgrad
Recompute B7 locally → WGMMA → add B9 → BF16 dx_n
B11 + B12 · input LN backward + residual
dx_n stays in registers; saved mean/inverse std reused
BF16 LN-gradient rounding → residual add → TMA dx store
LN runs while next gate loads; last P overlaps X/residual loads
Grid completion + parameter reduction · still the SAME kernel launch
FP32 partials → dW_left, dW_left_gate, dW_right, dW_right_gate, dγ, dβ
Shared buffers + registers hold large intermediates. Partial reduction uses global memory and two counters.
B7 is evaluated in both CTA roles. Fusion removes materialization; it does not eliminate all recomputation.
Full backward, same B1–B6: 1090 → 860 µs / 4350 → 3527 µs
Target ≥1.7× and supported SoL90: not reached. Production dispatch unchanged.
Warm CUDA graphs, 600 samples/path, node02 · arithmetic/rounding contract checked with dropout off/on
